name: SiteSkyline Email Campaign Manager
author: Sky Plugins

sections.description:
SiteSkyline Email Campaign Manager is a WordPress email automation plugin that lets you build trigger-based, multi-step email sequences without a monthly SaaS subscription. Unlike most WooCommerce email plugins, SiteSkyline doesn’t stop at order events — it can also launch campaigns from WordPress user registrations and form submissions (Contact Form 7, WPForms, and Ninja Forms), so you can automate email marketing even on a site that doesn’t sell anything.

Every email lives inside a visual sequence builder with conditional branching — send a different follow-up depending on whether the last email was opened, clicked, or ignored — and every campaign step supports merge tags, a live desktop/mobile preview, and optional unique WooCommerce coupon generation per recipient.

Why site owners choose SiteSkyline Email Campaign Manager

  • Not locked to WooCommerce. Trigger campaigns from WooCommerce order events, WordPress Core user registration, or Contact Form 7 / WPForms / Ninja Forms submissions — all from the same builder.
  • Visual email sequence builder. Chain follow-up emails based on whether a previous email was opened, not opened, clicked, or not clicked, with configurable delays between each step.
  • 15 pre-built campaign templates. Ready-made sequences for Welcome & Onboarding, Purchase & Post-Purchase, Customer Retention, and Lifecycle & VIP goals — activate and customize in minutes.
  • Built-in open & click tracking. Every campaign email includes tracking pixels and wrapped links, with results rolled up into an analytics dashboard (overview stats, 14-day activity chart, per-campaign breakdown, and top-clicked links).
  • Dynamic, one-time-use coupons. Generate a unique WooCommerce coupon per recipient per email step, with configurable discount type, amount, expiry, and minimum cart total.
  • Smart audience targeting. Filter campaigns by product category, tag, brand, SKU, order total, customer lifetime value, order count, days since signup or last purchase, or form field values.
  • Custom trigger definitions. Turn any WordPress or WooCommerce hook into a campaign trigger by defining a key, label, and expected data type (Order ID, User ID, or none).
  • Product brand targeting. Adds a lightweight Brand taxonomy to WooCommerce products so you can target campaigns by the brand a customer purchased.
  • Full queue and delivery visibility. Monitor scheduled, failed, and sent emails in a searchable queue, and send test emails with sample merge-tag data before going live.
  • Built-in unsubscribe & preference center. One-click unsubscribe, a confirmation page, a suppression list, and an optional Email Preferences tab inside WooCommerce My Account.
  • No data leaves your site. All tracking, subscriber, and analytics data is stored in your own WordPress database.

Unlock Pro Automation Power

Upgrade to SiteSkyline Email Campaign Manager Pro to supercharge your store’s revenue and automation:

  • Visual Drag & Drop Email Builder. Design beautiful, high-converting emails visually with an intuitive drag-and-drop editor.
  • 30+ Professional Pre-built Templates. Instant access to 30+ responsive email templates for flash sales, newsletters, VIP rewards, back-in-stock alerts, and seasonal gift guides.
  • 10 Pre-built Multi-Step Broadcast Campaigns. Launch automated broadcast sequences with multi-step follow-ups for openers, non-openers, clickers, and non-clickers.
  • AI-Powered Campaign & Copy Generation. Generate complete email campaigns, subject lines, and persuasive copy automatically in seconds with built-in AI.
  • Advanced Segmented Broadcast Mode. Send blasts to your whole list or target specific micro-segments by user role, product purchased, minimum spend, or 30/60/90-day inactivity.
  • Priority Premium Support & 1-Click Updates. Get dedicated priority assistance and seamless automatic plugin updates directly in WordPress.

Where this fits

  • Post-purchase and win-back sequences for WooCommerce stores
  • Welcome and onboarding sequences for any WordPress site with user registration — no store required
  • Lead-nurture sequences triggered by Contact Form 7, WPForms, or Ninja Forms submissions
  • Re-engagement emails based on open/click behavior, without leaving WordPress

sections.installation:
1. Upload the siteskyline-email-campaign-manager folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly through Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Go to Email Manager in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Browse the pre-built campaign templates on the dashboard, or click New Campaign to launch the Campaign Builder Wizard and choose your trigger source (WooCommerce, WordPress Core, or a supported form plugin).
  5. Visit Email Manager → Settings to set your From Name, From Email, and unsubscribe preferences before activating your first campaign.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce to use this plugin?

No. WooCommerce unlocks order-based triggers, product/brand targeting, and dynamic coupons, but you can also build full email sequences using the WordPress user registration trigger or a supported form plugin (Contact Form 7, WPForms, Ninja Forms) with no WooCommerce dependency at all.

Does this work with Contact Form 7, WPForms, or Ninja Forms?

Yes. Select any of these as your trigger source in the Campaign Builder, choose the specific form, and optionally add field-value conditions (equals, contains, not empty) so only matching submissions start a campaign. Submitted field values are available as merge tags in your emails.

Can I send a welcome email sequence when someone registers on my WordPress site?

Yes. Choose “WordPress Core” as the trigger source and select the New User Registration event. You can restrict the sequence to specific user roles, such as Subscriber or Customer, so different roles get different onboarding emails.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. Campaign emails are self-contained HTML and are not affected by your active theme’s styling.

Where is open and click tracking data stored?

All tracking data is stored in custom tables in your own WordPress database. No data is sent to third-party services.

Can I create my own custom triggers?

Yes. Under Settings → Custom Triggers, you can turn any WordPress or WooCommerce hook into a campaign trigger by giving it a key, label, hook name, and data type.

Can each recipient get a unique coupon code?

Yes. Enable Dynamic Coupon on any email step to generate a real, single-use WooCommerce coupon per recipient, with your choice of percentage or fixed discount, expiry, and optional minimum cart total.

Is there a way to test a campaign before it goes live?

Yes. Use the Send Test button in the campaign editor to email yourself a preview with sample merge-tag data, tracking pixels, and wrapped links included — the subject line is prefixed with [TEST] so it’s easy to spot.
